newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: FORECAST-Ayala Corp '96 net seen up 33 pct.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Ayala Corp '96 net seen up 33 pct.

text.p: Ayala Corp, a leading Philippine conglomerate, is likely to post a 33 percent increase in net profits in 1996 to 5.56 billion pesos, according to a Reuters poll.

Strong performances of its units and affiliates are expected to boost the company's earnings from the 4.18 billion pesos net profit recorded in 1995, said analysts from five securities firms, who were polled this week.
In 1997, Ayala Corp's net profit is projected to rise by 27 percent to 7.068 billion pesos, the analysts said.
The poll stripped out extraordinary gains arising from Ayala Corp's sale of Ayala Land shares in 1995 which are likely to be booked in 1996.
